inputs.text:
Folks, it is crystal clear what happens when we abandon traditional duty and foundational pillars for elite self-interest. Look at Nigeria right now, where their political parties are devolving into exclusive country clubs for the ultra-wealthy instead of standing as the backbone of representation. 

Take a hard look at the ruling All Progressives Congress (APC) and their preparations ahead of the 2027 general elections. Personal ambition and cash are actively replacing basic civic accountability, moral duty, and true community representation. When these institutions turn their backs on their foundational responsibilities to serve the people and instead cater purely to the wealthy elite, social order inevitably collapses and the traditional fabric of society pays the heavy price. This is the bitter fruit of a system where money replaces moral duty.
